mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE MoM > 0.5% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow slower than GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth < GDPC1 growth for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth < GDPC1 growth for 2 consecutive quarters does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2%, it signals a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of triggered instances.
